profile.role_note: Spectro sub-DPS and support; universal Liberation amplifier for burst teams; strong at S0.

pull_verdict.verdict: The safest rerun of 3.7 — pull her if you don't own her.

build.fast_path: Fast path: Spectrum Blaster (or Static Mist) + 5-piece Pact of Neonlight Leap with Hyvatia in the main slot, 4-3-3-1-1 layout. Main stats: Crit on the 4-cost, Spectro DMG on the 3-costs, ATK% on the 1-costs. Level her Forte Circuit first.

ranked_weapons.name: Spectrum Blaster
ranked_weapons.note: Crit Rate. Basic Attack DMG +36% on Intro/Basic hits, and inflicting Tune Rupture/Strain grants the whole team up to 24% All DMG. Best in slot by a clear margin.

ranked_weapons.name: Phasic Homogenizer
ranked_weapons.note: Crit DMG. ATK +12% and 20% All-Attribute DMG Bonus when a teammate casts a Tune Break skill. The strongest non-signature option.

ranked_weapons.name: Static Mist
ranked_weapons.note: Energy Regen. The support-oriented pick: smoother Liberation uptime and an ATK buff for the next character via her Outro.

ranked_weapons.name: Solar Flame
ranked_weapons.note: the recommended budget pick; stacks ATK and Heavy Attack DMG.

ranked_weapons.name: Cadenza / Relativistic Jet
ranked_weapons.note: serviceable fillers; Relativistic Jet helps Energy Regen for smoother rotations.

echo_sets.name: Pact of Neonlight Leap
echo_sets.note: 2-pc: +10% Spectro DMG. 5-pc: grants the next character 30% ATK and 10% All-Type DMG after Lynae casts her Outro Skill — the core of her buffer identity. Hyvatia: using her Intro Skill grants the next Resonator 10% All-Type DMG Bonus. Sub-DPS alternative main Echo: Twin Nova - Nebulous Cannon (boosts her own Basic Attack and Spectro DMG).

echo_sets.name: Moonlit Clouds
echo_sets.note: Placeholder while farming: Energy Regen plus an ATK buff for the next character.

echo_sets.name: Rite of Gilded Revelation
echo_sets.note: For a main-DPS Lynae build: Basic Attack hits stack Spectro DMG up to 3 times, and at max stacks her Liberation gains +40% Basic Attack DMG Bonus.

stat_priorities.note: Pick whichever balances your substats — Crit Rate if below ~70%.
Spectro DMG Bonus on both by default; Energy Regen on one piece if her Liberation isn't ready every rotation.

build.energy_regen_target: Comfort stat, not a breakpoint — most guides don't list a target

teams.name: Team 1 — Tune Rupture core: Aemeath + Lynae + Mornye

members.name: Aemeath
members.note: The main DPS: triggers Tune Rupture for massive damage. Both she and Lynae must be set to Tune Rupture Mode in the character menu for the team to work.

members.name: Lynae
members.note: The sub-DPS and buffer: applies Tune Rupture to feed Aemeath's stacks, grants All DMG buffs and Tune Break Boost, and her Outro hands Aemeath a big Resonance Liberation DMG boost right before her ultimate.

members.name: Mornye
members.note: The support and healer: heals, amplifies team-wide damage, and boosts the Off-Tune buildup rate so Tune Breaks land more often.

teams.rotation: Open with Mornye to heal and apply buffs, swap through Lynae (skill, then Liberation, then Outro into Aemeath), and let Aemeath take her long on-field window to detonate the Tune Rupture setups. Repeat — the buff windows are long enough that the order matters more than the speed.

teams.name: Team 2 — Liberation burst: Iuno + Lynae + Mornye

members.name: Iuno
members.note: The main DPS: her burst-heavy playstyle leans on Resonance Liberation, which is exactly what Lynae amplifies, and her own kit adds healing that keeps the team healthy.

members.name: Lynae
members.note: Her Liberation grants a team-wide damage buff and her Outro feeds Iuno both All DMG Amplification and Liberation DMG amplification — the ideal partner for Iuno's burst windows.

members.name: Mornye
members.note: Team-wide damage amp, healing, and interruption resistance for a comfortable rotation. Shorekeeper or Verina slot in fine if you don't own Mornye.

teams.rotation: Mornye first for buffs and healing, then Lynae's skill into her Liberation, then her Outro directly into Iuno — Iuno takes the field, spends her Liberation under the full stack of buffs, and heals the team while doing it.

teams.name: Team 3 — Budget: Lynae + Sanhua + Verina

members.name: Lynae
members.note: The team's entire engine: her All DMG and Liberation buffs lift Sanhua's damage far beyond what a 4-star could reach alone, and her own off-field hits keep damage flowing while she waits offstage.

members.name: Sanhua
members.note: The main DPS: a strong free/standard 4-star who takes the field, deals quick sword combos, and hands control back to Lynae between windows.

members.name: Verina
members.note: The sustain: heals and buffs with minimal field time, and her coordinated attacks chip in damage without stealing Sanhua's spotlight.

teams.rotation: Verina for heals and her damage buff, Lynae for skill into Liberation and Outro, then Sanhua's full field segment — the same buff-then-carry rhythm as the premium teams, just cheaper.
